concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-reporting-3d-secure-conversion-report]] — 2026-09-15 CET 3DS Conversion report column reference for transactions using 3DS, including directory/authentication and acquirer responses; it defines no conversion formula or payment-outcome proof.
warnings: The page is a column reference, not a rate-calculation or filtering specification; do not supply a denominator, access role or generation schedule from its title.
Keep report-level CET distinct from the transaction time_zone column and 3DS/authentication fields distinct from payment authorization, capture or settlement outcomes.
C and Y are labeled examples, not an exhaustive response-code map.
